gloss: to recur; to come back; to flare up again

definitions.gloss: to recur; to come back; to flare up again
definitions.explanation: Of an illness, pain, heat, or cold that seemed to be over: to return. Also used of a problem or dispute that had died down. The subject takes が.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぶり{返|かえ}した。
⟦{九月|くがつ}→九月：00646_kugatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{暑|あつ}さ→暑さ：12973_atsusa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぶり{返|かえ}した。
examples.english: The heat came back in September.

examples.japanese: ⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぶり{返|かえ}す⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦しばらく→しばらく：01267_shibaraku⟧⟦{安静|あんせい}→安静：12267_ansei⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: If I overdo things my back pain flares up again, so I'm taking it easy for a while.

notes:
Intransitive and godan: ぶり{返|かえ}す, ぶり{返|かえ}した. The word assumes the trouble had eased first, so it is used of a relapse, not of something that never stopped.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぶり{返|かえ}す: a cold comes back
- ⟦{暑|あつ}さ→暑さ：12973_atsusa⟧／⟦{寒|さむ}さ→寒さ：12336_samusa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぶり{返|かえ}す: the heat or the cold returns
- ⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぶり{返|かえ}す: the pain flares up again

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{再燃|さいねん}→再燃：11782_sainen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to flare up again — written style, used more of issues and disputes than of colds
- ⟦{再発|さいはつ}→再発：09017_saihatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to recur — the medical term for a disease returning
